question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — KIDS Act (H R 7757)
plain_language: This bill requires specified online platforms to establish safeguards for minors. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Small Business Technological Advancement Act (H R 915)
plain_language: This bill authorizes the Small Business Administration to finance, under its 7(a) loan program, business software or cloud computing services, including tools that use artificial intelligence. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Small Business Lending Fraud Prevention Act (H R 7401)
bill_title: Small Business Lending Fraud Prevention Act
plain_language: This bill requires Small Business Administration employees who take part in originating, reviewing, or approving agency loans to certify in writing that they have no conflict of interest with the loan and to disclose any conflict that arises later. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act (S 3971)
bill_title: Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act
plain_language: This bill reauthorizes through FY2031 and modifies the Small Business Innovation Research program, the Small Business Technology Transfer program, and related pilot programs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — AI for Main Street Act (H R 5764)
plain_language: This bill requires Small Business Development Centers to assist small businesses in evaluating artificial intelligence, including by providing best practices for using artificial intelligence and guidance about using artificial intelligence to plan for unexpected circumstances. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Main Street Parity Act (H R 5763)
plain_language: This bill lessens the financing requirements for certain Small Business Administration loans to small businesses for plant acquisition, construction, conversion, or expansion, including the acquisition of land. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.
